subject: Request: Senior sign-off for >20% Hosted API pricing for Zenith Cloud
messages:
From: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@zenithcloud.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Cc: Zenith Cloud Finance <finance@zenithcloud.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Hosted API pricing inquiry — large volume

Hi Michael,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — the integration looks solid. As discussed, we expect a material consumption ramp if performance and latency meet our needs. Attached is a conservative forecast for months 1–3 (expected ramp to ~250M tokens/month by month 3).

Given the scale and the fact we're evaluating Redwood for an embedded rewrite of our chat and assistant stack, we're looking for commercial terms that match our commitment. Specifically: a 12-month commit with 3-month ramp and an initial discount in the 20–25% range off list Hosted API usage rates.

Can Redwood consider a 22% off list for the first 12 months in exchange for a prepaid commitment (netting out to a minimum consumption guarantee)? Finance would like a simple term sheet we can circulate. I attached the forecast for context.

If this needs senior approval, please escalate — we have a tight procurement window and would like to get a term sheet by EOD Monday.

Thanks,
Sarah Liu
Head of Platform Partnerships
Zenith Cloud

Attachments: ZenithCloud_Month1-3_usage_forecast.xlsx (spreadsheet, 24KB)

From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@zenithcloud.com>
Date: Fri, 10 May 2029 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing inquiry — large volume

Ben / Marissa — forwarding Zenith's ask. Key points:
- Forecast: ~250M tokens/mo by month 3 (attached).
- Commercial ask: 22% off list Hosted API usage for a 12-month prepay/commit.
- Strategic rationale: potential marquee customer, strong marketplace signal, likely multi-product expansion (assistant + embeddings).

Quick math: at list rates this profile would be ~$1.2M ARR year 1; 22% concession reduces hosted revenue by ~$264k in gross billing for the committed period, but with prepay + SLA concessions we can protect margin and reduce churn risk.

Per pricing policy, any discount >20% requires senior approval. I'm attaching a proposed term sheet (v2) that includes: a minimum monthly usage floor, prepay schedule, early-termination fee, and language for a limited SLA addendum.

Request: Can we get senior pricing sign-off (SVP/Head of Revenue or Finance lead) to proceed with a formal term sheet to Zenith? If approved, AE will prepare DocuSign and coordinate legal on the SLA clause.

Michael
Director, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments: proposed_pricing_term_sheet_v2.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 13 May 2029 08:07:00 -0700
Subject: Escalation: Zenith Cloud — request for >20% Hosted API discount (deal ZD-2029-0427)

Mina — escalating for your review/approval. Summary below and attached materials.

Deal: Zenith Cloud (platform) — interested in moving core assistant traffic to Redwood Hosted API.
Ask: 22% off list Hosted API rates for a 12-month commitment (prepaid).
Commercial mitigations proposed:
- Minimum monthly usage guarantee (locked in in the SOW).
- Prepay of first 6 months on execution; balance quarterly.
- Early termination fee equal to remaining committed value (to protect revenue).
- Redwood to be listed as a preferred vendor/reference (marketing cooperation).

Financial impact: Estimated gross billing reduction ~$264k for year-1 vs list. We model positive cash flow due to prepay and expect expansion potential of 2–3x in year 2 if tech performance matches expectations.

Risks / asks for approval:
1) Pricing: Approve one-time exception to pricing policy to permit 22% hosted-rate concession on deal ZD-2029-0427.
2) SLA: Approve a limited SLA addendum (p80 latency SLO and standard incident credit — legal to scope; I attached SOA-SLA-exception-form).
3) Term: Approve 12-month committed term with minimums and prepay schedule as above.

Attachments: ZenithCloud_Month1-3_usage_forecast.xlsx; proposed_pricing_term_sheet_v2.pdf; SOA-SLA-exception-form.docx

Links: HubSpot deal: https://hubspot.redwood.ai/deal/ZD-2029-0427
DocuSign preview: https://docusign.com/envelope/XYZ-zenith-approval
Drive folder: https://drive.redwood.ai/drive/folders/zenith-cloud-pricing

If you need additional modeling, I can have finance run a margin sensitivity by EOD. We'd like to respond to Zenith by COB Monday to keep the procurement timeline.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Strategic Deals
Redwood Inference

From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Sun, 12 May 2029 15:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Escalation: Zenith Cloud — request for >20% Hosted API discount (deal ZD-2029-0427)

Team — after reviewing the materials and the proposed mitigations, I approve the requested 22% Hosted API concession for Zenith Cloud under the following conditions:

1) Prepay: First 6 months invoiced on signature and received within 30 days.
2) Minimums: The SOW must include the monthly minimums in the term sheet; finance to validate the minimums cover at least 70% of the expected variable cost plus a 10% margin buffer.
3) SLA: Legal to review the limited SLA addendum; any credit exposure must be capped at 15% of monthly invoice for the affected month.
4) Approval window: This approval is valid only if signatures are executed by 2029-05-31.

Please proceed to finalize DocuSign with the term sheet and route to Legal and Finance for the SLA and invoicing steps. Once we have signed docs and cleared finance, AE can provision the account with the agreed routing policy and monitoring hooks.

Good work — this looks like a strategically valuable early customer. Keep me posted on any redlines from their counsel.

-Mina Haddad
SVP, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Signature: Mina Haddad | SVP, Revenue Operations | mina.haddad@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
